IS 1904:1986.title: Code of practice for design and construction of foundations in soils: General requirements

clauses.7.1: Depth of foundation depends on: (a) securing adequate allowable bearing capacity, (b) in clayey soils, penetration below the zone where seasonal shrinkage/swelling and tree-root effects cause movement, (c) in fine sands and silts, penetration below the frost-affected zone.
clauses.13.2: Factor of safety for shallow foundations against overturning shall be not less than 1.5 when dead load, live load and earth pressures are considered together with wind or seismic load; not less than 2 when wind/seismic is excluded.
clauses.15.1.6: Where wind or seismic load is less than 25% of that due to dead and live loads, it may be neglected in foundation design.
clauses.15.1.7: Where wind or seismic load exceeds 25% of dead+live load, foundations shall be proportioned so pressure due to (dead+live+wind) does not exceed safe bearing capacity by more than 25%.
clauses.18.1: Safe bearing capacity for shallow foundations shall be calculated in accordance with IS 6403:1981.
clauses.14.1: Minimum horizontal spacing between an existing and a new footing shall be equal to the width of the wider footing.
clauses.10.2.4: On sloping sites, spread foundations shall be on a horizontal bearing and stepped; at changes of level, footings shall be lapped at steps for a distance at least equal to the foundation thickness or twice the step height, whichever is greater.

IS 383:1970.title: Specification for Coarse and Fine Aggregates from Natural Sources for Concrete

clauses.3.3: Aggregate crushing value shall not exceed 45% for aggregate used in concrete other than wearing surfaces, and 30% for concrete used in wearing surfaces (runways, roads, pavements).
clauses.4.1: Coarse aggregates shall be supplied in nominal single sizes per Table 2 (e.g. 40mm, 20mm, 10mm graded sizes).
clauses.Table 4: Fine aggregate grading zones I-IV: percentage passing 4.75mm IS sieve is 90-100% across all zones; 600-micron sieve passing ranges from 15-50% (Zone I) to 60-79% (Zone IV) — zone determines suitable fine:coarse aggregate ratio.
clauses.Table 5: All-in-aggregate grading for 40mm nominal size: 100% passing 80mm, 95-100% passing 40mm, 45-75% passing 20mm, 25-45% passing 4.75mm, 8-30% passing 600-micron.
clauses.3.6: Soundness test limits: coarse aggregate max 12% loss (sodium sulphate) / 18% (magnesium sulphate); fine aggregate max 10% / 15% respectively.

clauses.6.4.1: No bed joint shall be thicker than 12mm. For modular bricks conforming to IS 1077, four courses plus three joints shall measure 39cm; for traditional bricks, four times actual brick thickness plus 3cm.
clauses.Table 1: Brick selection by use: Class 12.5 common bricks for external walls exposed to weather and load-bearing walls; Class 7.5 for internal walls; heavy-duty bricks (IS 2180) for very heavy loading; bricks for plinth/foundation below damp course must be free from efflorescence.
clauses.6.7: Foundation footings in brickwork: refer IS 1080:1985 for construction.
clauses.6.8.4: All walls shall have a damp-proof course at least 15cm above finished ground/plinth protection level, running without a break throughout the wall length, including under door openings.
clauses.8.1.1(a): DPC concrete layer: 10mm nominal size aggregate (IS 383:1970), mix 1:2:4, thickness not less than 4cm, with waterproofing treatment.
clauses.11.10: Curing: brickwork shall be kept constantly wet for at least 7 days after laying (except mud-mortar brickwork), commencing 24 hours after the course is laid.
clauses.6.9.2: Wall ties in cavity walls: not more than 4 brick-lengths apart horizontally, not more than 5 brick-heights apart vertically, staggered; minimum 5 ties per m² of wall surface.
clauses.11.8.4: Crushing strength of bricks used in reinforced brick masonry shall not be less than 7.5 N/mm².

IS 875-2:1987.title: Code of Practice for Design Loads (Other Than Earthquake) - Part 2: Imposed Loads

clauses.Table 1(i)(a)1: Dwelling houses - all rooms and kitchens: imposed UDL 2.0 kN/m², concentrated load 1.8 kN.
clauses.Table 1(i)(a)3: Dwelling houses - corridors, passages, staircases including fire escapes and store rooms: UDL 3.0 kN/m² (store rooms 4.5 kN/m²).
clauses.Table 1(i)(a)4: Dwelling houses - balconies: UDL 3.0 kN/m², concentrated 1.5 kN/m run at outer edge.
clauses.3.2.1: Reduction in total imposed load for columns/walls per number of floors carried: 1 floor 0%, 2 floors 10%, 3 floors 20%, 4 floors 30%, 5-10 floors 40%, over 10 floors 50%.
clauses.Table 2(i): Flat/sloping/curved roof (slope <=10deg) with access provided: UDL 1.5 kN/m²; without access (maintenance only): 0.75 kN/m².
